CASE-2026-00478.description: The burner number 8899001122 called Meera Nair's registered number and ran the fraudulent KYC verification script.

CASE-2026-00478.title: Funds debited from victim's account

CASE-2026-00478.title: Funds moved onward to shell company
CASE-2026-00478.description: ₹7,10,000 was moved from the mule account to a current account held by Bright Future Fintech Pvt Ltd, the mule keeping the remainder.

CASE-2026-00478.title: Mule observed at cash-withdrawal point
CASE-2026-00478.description: Surveillance recorded Ankit Pillai collecting cash near Whitefield, Bengaluru on a Honda Activa registered to him.

CASE-2026-00478.title: FIR registered
CASE-2026-00478.description: Meera Nair filed a complaint at Koramangala Police Station; investigators later named Vikas Sharma and Ankit Pillai as accused.
